data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written
data.market_hours_note: FX is closed Friday ~22:00 UTC to Sunday ~22:00 UTC. Those bars are absent, never filled; the engine also zeroes the return across every closure and holds no position through one.
data.source: dukascopy tick data aggregated to bars, see data/manifest/

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable. Run diagnose.py --null afterwards for the cross-sectional picture; that is exploratory and must be labelled as such.

derived.note: Detection limit: the smallest TRUE annualised Sharpe this design could find with 80% power at alpha=0.05. A null result from this sweep says nothing about edges smaller than this.

hypothesis: A decisive break of structure is claimed to signal a directional regime change. Stated mechanically: A close beyond the prior lookback-bar extreme by at least entry_threshold ATR(14). This is the only market-structure concept with a fixed definition; anything requiring a chosen swing point or higher-timeframe bias is deliberately excluded as untestable. This sweep tests whether that produces a risk-adjusted edge after realistic costs, once selection across the full parameter space is accounted for. The definition is fixed and hashed before the test runs, so an objection that it was implemented wrong must be raised against this text in advance.

protocol.definition_note: These concepts are usually traded discretionarily. Only the mechanical core is tested here. A null result therefore falsifies the mechanical rule, not every possible discretionary application of the idea — and that limit is stated up front rather than conceded afterwards.
protocol.execution_model: signal from bar t close, held over bar t+1, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional per side
protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Every variant evaluated over the full period; in-sample/out-of-sample splitting is done by CSCV at scoring time.
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

search_space.enumeration_note: 6 lookback x 5 entry_threshold x 3 exit_rule x 3 holding_cap_bars x 3 symbols = 810 fully enumerated variants. No variant is excluded after the fact.

family_descriptions.break_of_structure: A close beyond the prior lookback-bar extreme by at least entry_threshold ATR(14). This is the only market-structure concept with a fixed definition; anything requiring a chosen swing point or higher-timeframe bias is deliberately excluded as untestable.

title: Break of structure on major FX pairs, hourly
